import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import pricing

for amount in (0, 5, 1234.5, 1234567.891, 0.005, 999.999, 19.99):
    print(amount, pricing.format_price_usd(amount), "|", pricing.format_price_chf(amount))
for text in ("$1,234.50", "CHF 19.99", "7"):
    print(text, pricing.parse_price(text))
assert pricing.format_price_usd(1234.5) == "$1,234.50"
assert pricing.format_price_chf(1234.5) == "CHF 1,234.50"
print("ok")
